host_processor_caches: L1d: 5.3 MiB (112 instances), L1i: 3.5 MiB (112 instances), L2: 224 MiB (112 instances), L3: 520 MiB (2 instances)
host_networking: 400 Gbps DCN per host (100 Gbps per chip), gVNIC Ethernet
accelerator_on-chip_memories: 2 TensorCores + 4 SparseCores per chip, each TensorCore with VMEM (on-chip SRAM)
accelerator_interconnect_topology: 3D torus. Disaggregated RL: Trainer 1 x 4x4x8 slice (2 x 4x4x4 cubes, 128 chips) + Rollout 128 x 2x2x1 single-host slices (4 chips each, 512 chips); Trainer-to-Rollout weight sync over DCN
hw_notes: [TPU compute: 640 chips / 160 hosts] Disaggregated RL system totaling 640 TPU7x (Ironwood) chips (1280 TensorCores / JAX devices) across 160 x tpu7x-standard-4t GCE hosts (2 sockets x 56 cores = 112 cores / 224 vCPUs, 960 GB RAM, 4 TPU7x chips per host): (1) Trainer: 1 x tpu7x-4x4x8 slice (32 hosts, 128 TPU7x chips / 256 TensorCores) running Pathways; (2) Rollout: 128 x tpu7x-2x2x1 single-host slices (128 hosts, 512 TPU7x chips / 1024 TensorCores, 1 host / 4 chips / 8 TensorCores per slice) running vLLM on tpu-inference (jobset.tpu.yaml, DP=1, EP=8, TP=1). [CPU: use per run and shared GKE node pools] Each run uses 1 node for the Tunix RL controller and 1 node for the Pathways head and trainer client (c3d-standard-60: 60 vCPUs, 240 GB RAM per node), and up to 4096 concurrent k8s-agent-sandbox R2E-Gym execution and verification pods (per pod: an agent container with 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB request and 2 vCPU / 4 GiB limit, and a grading container of the same task image with 0.05 vCPU / 128 MiB request). These run on GKE CPU node pools shared by the concurrent runs on the cluster: 508 sandbox nodes for the k8s-agent-sandbox pods (198 x c3d-standard-60-lssd: 60 vCPUs, 240 GB RAM, 4 x 375 GB local SSD; 310 x c3d-standard-90-lssd: 90 vCPUs, 360 GB RAM, 8 x 375 GB local SSD; 39,780 vCPUs total, of which each run used only a fraction: 6,160 vCPUs / ~15.5% requested for the 11,200 pre-warmed pods across 700 task images x 16 replicas, and 1,681-1,734 vCPUs requested / 6,112-6,304 vCPUs limit at 3,056-3,152 peak active concurrent pods); 1 x c3d-standard-60-lssd for the agent-sandbox controller; c3d-standard-60 nodes for the Tunix RL controller and the Pathways heads. [Offline evaluation, not timed] The scored checkpoints were evaluated offline on 32 x tpu7x-2x2x4 slices (512 TPU7x chips).
framework: Tunix 0.1.8; MaxText 0.2.4 (@ e526ea02); vLLM 0.28.1rc1.dev500+g51da0ca66.tpu with tpu-inference @ dbc73c36; JAX 0.11.0; libtpu 0.0.44
operating_system: Container Debian 13 (trixie), Python 3.12.15; GKE 1.36.4-gke.1247000 nodes: Container-Optimized OS from Google (TPU hosts, RL controller, Pathways heads) and Ubuntu 24.04 (sandbox nodes)
sw_notes: Disaggregated GRPO training on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Tunix runs asynchronous, in-flight GRPO (max_staleness=2); MaxText trains the policy on the trainer slice with Pathways (tpu7x:4x4x8, FSDP=32, CP=4, EP=2, TP=1); vLLM + tpu-inference generates the rollouts on 128 single-host slices (tpu7x:2x2x1, DP=1, EP=8, TP=1); Raiden (tpu_sync_jax) transfers the weights from the trainer to the rollout over DCN; and k8s-agent-sandbox runs isolated Kubernetes pods for multi-turn OpenHands CodeActAgent R2E-Gym environment interaction and reward evaluation.
